services.desc: As we continue to celebrate the 200th anniversary of the opening of the Mount Vernon Hotel and America’s 250th, we hope you’ll stop by for a tour and to view Treasures from the Collection: Founding Fathers. Showcasing some of our most important collection objects related to Founding Fathers George Washington, John Adams, and more, this exhibition will be included in every tour and will be on display until early July-don’t miss it! In the 1820s and 1830s, life in America was rapidly changing, nowhere more so than in New York City. blurb: T he Mount Vernon Hotel Museum & Garden (MVHM&G) is a landmarked historic house museum in Manhattan that preserves one of the few remaining 18th-century buildings in New York City. Built in 1799 and converted into a popular day resort in 1826, the museum brings early 19th-century New York to life through guided tours of its period rooms and tranquil garden.
